PKG_FMT 8 -> 10 and DRV_VER 9 -> 11 (SPEC.md 20.2.0): the RAM disk's class moved 5 -> 8 (DRVC_FILE -> DRVC_FILE2, SPEC.md 62.9.19), which the round's entry above recorded as an addition. It is not: RAMDISK.DRV's header class and RD_CLASS (drivers/ramdisk/rdpkg.inc, outside the locked surface) both name 8 now and drv_tab row 3 expects it, so an old RAMDISK.DRV would have been refused by drv_check as a bad driver, and an old package reaching the RAM disk through RD_CLASS - THEWIRE.O88's archive path - would have called class 5, NET.DRV's slot, and been told there is no RAM disk. At the new numbers that package is Wrong os8088 version (LD_EVER) at load and that driver fails on its version byte. 10 and 11 collide with no number ever used (module 5, package 3/6/8, driver 4/7/9) nor with each other.
